rows.en:
All right… We'll support Hayata from the ground!

Hayata! Don't push yourself until we get there! Understood?

Roger!

So this is the dragon that was drawn in that mural?

Cut open Goro Watari's head and implant this device in it!

It works as a remote control. Push this button, and Goro Watari's brain will be under our control at will!

Goro Watari… You will become a member of the Desper Army!
Kuh…
Inform me as soon as the surgery is finished! I'm going outside to dispose of the maggots!

Struggling is useless! You can't use your psychic powers!

Goro Watari… To transform into Sanagiman and then [VAR6], you need more psychic energy…

But… right now, you don't have that energy! Begin the surgery!
(Damn… What do I do? What can I do…)
Ha ha ha… Give up! It's too late!! Goro Watari's modification surgery has begun!
No way…!?
No way…!?

It's no lie!

Goro Watari will become a Desper Soldier! Our comrade… a warrior who fights to destroy mankind.
Nonsense!? Goro Watari, [VAR6], is a champion of justice!
That's a lie! I don't believe it! Goro is a champion of justice!
That's a lie! I don't believe it! Goro is a champion of justice!
Ha ha ha… That is for Goro Watari to decide! You'll see soon enough! Let's go!
([HERO4]… I need your help! Please…)

(…!?

Goro? Is that you, Goro? No way? Huh… where are you?)

(…!?

Goro? Is that you, Goro? No way? Huh… where are you?)

(Sorry… I didn't mean to startle you…

Anyway, right now we're talking by telepathy.)
(What…!? But I don't have that kind of power…)
(What…!? But I don't have that kind of power…)

(…You do! You just haven't noticed it.

Your mysterious power, [HERO4], is similar to my psychic powers… With it, I might be able to get the power I need to transform…)
(What should I do?)
(What should I do?)

(Concentrate your will on me! The stronger, the better!

Keep concentrating until I've built up the energy I need to transform! There isn't much time left!)
(Got it, I'll try!)
(Got it, I'll try!)

…!?

[HERO4]! What are you doing at a time like this! Hey, [HERO4]!

…!?

[HERO4]! What are you doing at a time like this! Hey, [HERO4]!
All right! Covering fire! Get as close as you can and aim for its eyes.

All right! Covering fire!

Ultraman took care of the kaiju, but the Desper Army and Kelbaan's forces are still left! Use the new weapon! Understood?
Warrior of freedom, [VAR6]!!
Thank you, [HERO4]! Thanks to you, I was able to transform!

She was concentrating for my sake. I never knew [HERO4]'s power was this great…

Thank you so much!!
What… happened to me?
What… happened to me?
I didn't do anything… But I was a help. I guess I'm not so bad after all, huh?
I didn't do anything… But I was a help. I guess I'm not so bad after all, huh?
Desper Army… I won't forgive you!!
Did the surgery fail!? Curse you, [VAR6]!! Attack!!
Grr… You'll pay for this!! Udesper will not die! I will not die!
So in the end the kaiju died too…

I'm sorry it came to this.

But… if we'd let it live, the damage would only have kept piling up…

It's a pity we couldn't unravel the secret of its 7,000-year life…

But it seems certain that the mummy and the kaiju had some mysterious connection…
If only we hadn't dug them up, and let them sleep on for a hundred or two hundred years…
If only we'd known from the start it would turn out like this… We did a cruel thing.

Be that as it may…

Dr. Iwamoto, I hear you'll be joining the TDF science group?

Mm…

I thought there might be something I could help with too… I look forward to working with you from now on.
The mummy and the kaiju who woke from a 7,000-year sleep… Their connection was never unraveled, but the sight of the kaiju that appeared to protect the mummy and died was a pitiful one.
In history… there are pages that must not be opened. Perhaps the Science Patrol confirmed that truth firsthand…
That's weird? That guy… is he really not Ultraman?
Capture the Mummy Man!
Defeat the Mummy Man and the Desper Soldiers!
Defeat Mummy Kaiju Dodongo and all Desper Soldiers!
Defeat Mummy Kaiju Dodongo, Udesper and all Desper Soldiers!
Defeat Mummy Kaiju Dodongo, Kelbaan's forces, Gigant, Udesper and all Desper Soldiers!
Defeat Kelbaan's forces, Gigant and the entire Desper Army!
Chief Kitakura is defeated, or the Mummy Man is killed
Chief Kitakura or [HERO4] is defeated, or the Mummy Man is killed
Chief Kitakura or [HERO4] is defeated
Over Oshima… a jumbo airliner was attacked and crashed! An hour later, the control tower's communication records revealed that the incident was the work of a flying battleship.
Furthermore, the TDF, the Red Muffler Squad and other organizations gathered and sorted the information, and determined that the battleship was a Brain Party robot…
Mister Brain! The Battleship Robot test was a great success!
A natural outcome…

With that Battleship Robot, we can bomb and destroy every city in Japan!

Heh heh heh… Let's attack right away, Mister Brain!
Hustler… Before that, there is still the second test.

A second test?

I haven't heard anything about that!
There's no need for you to hear of it! I am the one who decides… Hustler!
Hmph… What kind of test is it, Mister Brain?
A battle between a human and One-Seven's computer! That pilot's reflexes are outstanding!
Hmm… And with that, can we beat One-Seven, Mister Brain?
That is what the test is for, Hustler… We will launch a surprise attack on the TDF's First Combat Air Base! The Security Unit is on patrol there.

I see… If we hit the Security Unit, Saburo Minami will come out! Which means One-Seven too…

Ha ha ha… Just what I'd expect from the great Mister Brain, eh?
The Battleship Robot's course will be controlled by his helmet.

You there! I'll control the Battleship Robot through that helmet!

You go and give One-Seven a thrashing!
Sir!
Professor Hustler…

…!?

Who are you people?
I invited them!
We are of the battle-fleet nation Naager, purveyors of strategic weapons.

uncertain: U07303: 変転 is Inazuman's own word for transforming; rendered "transform" (not a glyph error).
U07307 etc.: Velvet/Vortex speak the same lines as [HERO4]/[HERO2] (presumably default or alternate hero names); translated identically.
U07313-U07324: 『』 telepathic speech rendered in ( ) like thoughts.
U07331: [VAR6] refers to [HERO4] as "She" (heroine, established female).
U07338: ウデスパーは死なん! 死なんのだ! — second sentence rendered "I will not die!" (Udesper speaking of himself in third person).
U07350: ミイラ味各 read as ミイラ人間 (Mummy Man); could be ミイラ怪獣.
U07353/U07354: ケルバーン in lists rendered "Kelbaan's forces".
U07363/U07365/U07369: ハスラー君 rendered "Hustler" (Brain's condescending address).
U07370/U07372: ワンセンブン typo for ワンセブン, rendered One-Seven.

new_names.why: from glossary ブレイン党操縦士
